title: US Patient Care Summary (US-PCS) Implementation Guide
introduction:
This Implementation Guide defines a FHIR U.S. Patient Summary (US-PCS), aligned with the International Patient Summary (IPS) implementation guide and derived from the FHIR Clinical Documents implementation guide. US Core profiles are used wherever possible; any deviations followed the Cross-Group Projects Work Group variance process with documented approval. It incorporates US-specific requirements including United States Core Date for Interoperability (USCDI) elements where appropriate for a Patient Summary. 
 The IPS universal guide provides a concise, specialty-agnostic summary of essential clinical data (e.g., allergies, medications, problems) to support unscheduled care, particularly in emergency scenarios, and is also applicable to planned care and care transitions. 
 This US-PCS Implementation Guide preserves IPS principles while addressing U.S. needs, including terminology considerations for cross-border interoperability and guidance on alignment with CDA-based CCD exchange.
